ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 75% of the fluke surface, contrasted against low-intensity black pixels along the trailing edges and central peduncle region comprising the remaining 25%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white zones cover the central lobes. Low-intensity dark pigmentation is mapped to the trailing edge margins, the central notch region, and a prominent irregular cluster in the lower-inner quadrant of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated aperture of approximately 75 degrees; the vertex of the notch is partially obscured by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations are present across the entire trailing edge. The left lobe exhibits larger, irregularly spaced indentations, while the right lobe shows a more uniform high-frequency jagged boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Inferior edges follow a smooth convex curve. Superior trailing edges follow a general convex arc from the notch to the distal tips, significantly modulated by extreme surface raggedness.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparsely distributed small, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible across the high-intensity white regions of both lobes, particularly in the medial areas.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark-intensity vertical linear streaks are visible on both lobes. A prominent, high-contrast vertical linear disruption is located on the distal third of the right fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive, irregular tissue loss and extreme serration along the entire trailing edge. A distinct dark vertical scar is present on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The distal tip of the left fluke lobe exhibits significant asymmetric erosion and tissue loss compared to the right tip, resulting in a blunt, irregular geometric termination.
